labels.consumption: Top consumers — oil demand, all liquids

production.n: EIA International Energy Data, crude oil including lease condensate production; world total as published by EIA (all countries)

consumption.n: EIA International Energy Data, petroleum and other liquids consumption: total oil demand, all liquids (the EIA series 'refined petroleum products consumption' carries the same values); world total as published by EIA (all countries)

rows.n: No crude oil from Russia to Turkey is recorded in customs data for 2022 to 2024 (4.2 Mt in 2021, CEPII BACI). Incomplete declarations by both sides may be the cause; it is not established here.

13% of tonnage estimated from value; Crude oil exports of the United Arab Emirates in customs data (184 Mt in 2024, CEPII BACI) are 100% of its production (183 Mt, EIA International Energy Data). 24.5 Mt of these exports are Atlas estimates from declared value. Crude of other origins loaded or blended in the country and declared as Emirati is a plausible cause; it is not established here.

exports.n: CEPII BACI HS92 crude oil (HS 2709), 2024, all transport modes, gross weight; world = sum of all reported flows in the Atlas BACI extract (flows below 1,000 t and 1 M USD omitted); 1% of world tonnage estimated from value where missing or inconsistent

rows.n: Crude oil from Mexico to "Other Asia, not elsewhere specified" (BACI code S19), shown here as Taiwan: 2.78 Mt in 2018, 13.1 Mt in 2019, 12.7 Mt in 2020, 15.2 Mt in 2021, 9.99 Mt in 2022, 8.43 Mt in 2023, 7.88 Mt in 2024 (CEPII BACI). No source read for the atlas confirms the destination.

imports.n: CEPII BACI HS92 crude oil (HS 2709), 2024, all transport modes, gross weight; world = sum of all reported flows in the Atlas BACI extract (flows below 1,000 t and 1 M USD omitted); 1% of world tonnage estimated from value where missing or inconsistent

flows.n: customs total for all modes: this trade moves both by sea and overland and the split is not known
Atlas estimate: CEPII BACI reports 152 Mt for USD 14.7 bn (97.3 USD/t, 0.16 times the 2024 median unit value of crude oil); tonnage = declared value divided by that unit value, 602 USD/t

notes: Production is in kb/d (EIA); trade tables are in Mt/year (BACI tonnage). Conversion depends on grade, so none is applied.
Oil demand is EIA petroleum and other liquids consumption: all liquids, not crude alone. The same table is shown under refined products.
No proved-reserves series exists in the EIA bulk file used (INTL.txt).

Unrecorded shipments, or cargoes declared under other origins, are a plausible cause; it is not established here.
